content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Posts are filled on regular basis Waiting list valid upto one year from the date of its preparation

content_sections.heading: How Will GSPCB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written examination (MCQ, 75 marks, one and half hour) Verification of documents Selection strictly as per marks in written examination; no marks for educational qualifications Konkani section of 10 marks; only candidates scoring minimum 04 marks are evaluated further Minimum passing marks: UR and Ex-Serviceman 45%, OBC 40%, ST/PwD 35% Tie: older date of birth ranks first, then higher educational qualification

content_sections.heading: GSPCB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Multiple Choice Questions; total 75 marks; one and half hour Report 30 minutes before scheduled examination time Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour for visual impairment, cerebral palsy and locomotor disabilities Distribution of marks is indicative; minor variations may be made

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of Educational Qualification with marksheet Valid Employment Exchange, Goa / Valid Employment Registration Card Valid 15 years Residence Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of the State of Goa Birth Certificate and photo identity proof issued by State Government Valid Caste Certificate / Disabilities Certificate, if applicable Work experience certificate; NOC for Government servants; Sainik Welfare card for Ex-Servicemen

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSPCB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online on the portal https://cbes.goa.gov.in from 11/11/2026 to 30/11/2026. Register/apply with a valid Email-ID and mobile number. Fill the Application Form along with the Declaration online. Submit a separate Application Form for each post, if eligible. No application accepted after 30/11/2026 or in any other mode.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All communication only on the Email ID given in the Application Form; no hard copy sent Exam date will be intimated through the GSPCB website and a local daily Certificates must be valid on the date of filing of application Scribe or reader seekers must inform GSPCB in advance with Appendix I and II

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. Applications opened on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 1 Scientific Assistant (Microbiology), 1 Scientific Assistant, 4 Laboratory Attendant, 2 Multi-tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years. Relaxation: Government servants upto 05 years, SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years, PwD (SC/ST) 15 years, PwD (OBC) 13 years, Ex-servicemen As per Rules in force, Overall subject to maximum 56 years to all categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 6 for Scientific Assistant (Microbiology), Level 6 for Scientific Assistant, Level 1 for Laboratory Attendant, Level 1 for Multi-tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scientific Assistant (Microbiology): Master's Degree in Microbiology/ Marine Microbiology; Scientific Assistant: Master's Degree in Chemistry/any branch of Environmental Sciences; Laboratory Attendant: Passed Secondary School certificate/examination; Multi-tasking Staff: Passed Secondary School Certificate/examination OR ITI course or equivalent trade. All posts: Knowledge of Konkani and 15 years Residence certificate. Laboratory Attendant and Multi-tasking Staff: at least one year working. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani essential for all posts. 15 years Residence certificate essential for all posts. Government servants must possess NOC of the employer.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates found ineligible at document verification will not be considered even after passing the written examination. Soliciting or canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written examination (MCQ, 75 marks, one and half hour). Verification of documents. Selection strictly as per marks in written examination; no marks for educational qualifications. Konkani section of 10 marks; only candidates scoring minimum 04 marks are evaluated further.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are filled on regular basis. Waiting list valid upto one year from the date of its preparation.
